symptom: v014 produced a dark graybox without foliage/depth; v015 had a black sky void; v016 sky composite was blocked with blocked_missing_required_edit_lora. The failed route also attempted live-action body/head swap nodes in the cartoon pipeline.
verification: S01_A_SKY_COMPOSITE_BLOCKER.json correctly blocked GPU submission, and the live /object_info/LoRA inspection confirmed the bare graph lacked a task-compatible edit LoRA. Resolution scope is graph rejection/domain isolation, not visual acceptance of a replacement cartoon image.
limitations: No stylized cartoon background was generated from the bare Krea2 graph. Either Krea2 Identity Edit V2 or General Edit V2 may be correct depending on the task; the alternate hybrid cartoon route remains required until the replacement graph and output are reviewed.
root_cause: Krea2EditModelPatch requires a task-compatible V2 edit LoRA immediately after UNETLoader: identity edit for person restaging or general edit for instruction-based scene/attribute changes. The incident graph was bare while photorealistic swap LoRAs were present instead. NEWTECONS live-action nodes were also inappropriately attempted in the stylized cartoon route.
fix_or_workaround: Preflight the selected task-compatible LoRA, its upstream binding and installed hash, then withhold graph generation when it is missing or mismatched. Enforce strict domain isolation between jenniejoy_cartoon_3d and newtecons_live_action.
prevention: Select and verify the identity-versus-general edit LoRA according to task before queuing. Never require General Edit for every edit and never import photorealistic swap nodes into the cartoon 3D pipeline.
